title: A small circle, a clear choice
context: An original fictional visual vignette; no historical event is asserted.
drawing: Flat color animation with soft closed silhouettes. People have oversized rounded heads, compact solid trunks, and broad rounded arm and leg shapes that carry visible mass. Small paddle-shaped hands and blunt feet finish the silhouette. Two upright dark pill marks are the only facial marks: no mouth, nose, brows, pupils or eye shine. Clothing covers the body normally, with no anatomy visible through fabric. Read emotion from posture, head angle and pauses. Use quiet edges and limited shading; avoid glossy toy surfaces and mechanical additions.

cast.lead: A compact plain mascot with a white filled round face and a narrow ink-dark edge, two dark vertical pill eyes, and an ink-dark solid torso. Its broad filled arms, legs, small paddle hands and rounded feet are also ink-dark. No hair, clothing, accessories, mouth, nose or eyebrows. The featureless body is about four head-heights tall.

props.item: A single thick gold ring, large enough to hold with one hand; an abstract graphic object, not jewelry.

exclude: Hairline arms or legs, empty ring heads, extra facial marks, cloned people or objects, anatomy showing through clothing, unrequested lettering, watermarks and brand marks.

shots.setting: A pure-white flat graphic field. No texture, gradients, horizon, floor shadows or environmental depth. One gold ring is separated from the mascot by a small clear gap.

item.place: within the white graphic field to the person’s right

beats.action: Close three-quarter framing. The mascot turns toward the gold ring and reaches with the right hand.
The right hand makes contact with the ring and closes around one side; the ring stays a single object.
The mascot lifts the ring to chest height and holds still, with the left arm relaxed.
